info.title: Legal Compliance Checker — frontend API baseline
info.description: Implementation-aligned FE/BE contract: 26 handlers. Runtime schema is /openapi.json. Auth on accepts HttpOnly session cookie or Bearer; auth off is local development. Structural schemas do not replace business/authorization checks. Decimal amounts may be strings.

post.description: Authorize actor (role reviewer); validate target case/run membership and expected hash under a per-run lock (409 STALE_REVIEW when another review changed the target). Backend supplies review ID, actor, before state, time and deployment. OVERRIDE requires schema-valid values for the target's editable fields; machine output is never overwritten. Events are append-only and mirrored to runtime.nhat_ky_review.

post.description: Require publish permission and expected_review_revision matching both the run's current reviews and this report version (rebuild the report after new reviews). Reject with 409 REVIEW_REQUIRED when there is no review, a REQUEST_MORE_EVIDENCE/REJECT decision is open, or a NON_COMPLIANT/PARTIAL requirement or HIGH/CRITICAL risk is not confirmed. Publication is a new immutable PUBLISHED version; repeating the call returns it. A review of an older run cannot approve this report.

get.description: Require export permission; preserve report ID/version and provenance. Unpublished exports visibly retain DRAFT/REVIEW_REQUIRED markings. Every export carries a verification stamp (report ID/version/status, run, review revision, SHA-256 of the stored report JSON with sorted keys, source SHA-256, knowledge snapshot, rule/knowledge versions, publication and export actor/time); the digest is also sent as X-Report-SHA256. format=json returns {verification, report} with the exact stored report.
